init_multiprocessing: initialize training stats for collecting statistics across multiple processes and devices
report: broadcast a set of scalars to all Collector instances across device and process boundaries
report0: broadcast scalars from the first process only while ignoring other processes
Collector_update: copy internal counters to user-visible state and reset them for the next round
Collector_as_dict: return accumulated averages as an EasyDict with num, mean, and std for each statistic
